title: Tehran - Friday, September 18th - The Great 313,000 "Janfedayan-e Iran" (Devotees of Iran) Rally
text:
Tehran - Friday, September 18th - The Great 313,000 "Janfedayan-e Iran" (Devotees of Iran) Rally"

"⏺️▶️The "Janfedayan-e Iran" (Devotees of Iran) rally is a large-scale public mobilization drill organized by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to strengthen the security and authority of the capital, demonstrate institutional synergy between the IRGC and police, and prepare for potential threats as a display of national unity and readiness in the face of external threats."

" The number 313,000 is symbolically significant in Shia tradition, referring to the number of companions expected to gather around the Twelfth Imam, al-Mahdi, in end-times prophecy."

"The "Janfada" (self-sacrifice) mobilization campaign was launched by Iranian religious organizations amid rising tensions with the US and Israel. State media reported the campaign has attracted over 31 million volunteers nationwide.
